reason: User asked whether porosity_thetap1+=divv omits the neighbor solid fraction (1-nj). Read-only source/paper clarification; no production equation changed.

source.theta: src/source/JSphCpu.cpp:2552-2553: divv=Vj*(vj-vi).corrected_gradW; sum into theta,not directly dn/dt.
source.integration: ComputeSymplecticPrePorosity/ComputeSymplecticCorrPorosity integrate Jdot=J*theta using existing force-stage midpoint values.
source.porosity: GetPorosityFeedbackStateCpu derives n=1-(1-n0)/J. This enforces the algebraic incompressible-grain identity (1-n)*J=1-n0 and implies the continuous local relation ndot=(1-ni)*theta_i. It does not make a finite-step n update identical to directly midpoint-integrating n.

discrete_difference: With the same Vj,velocity differences and corrected gradient, paper24 minus the instantaneous local-J-derived rate is sum_j Vj*(ni-nj)*(vj-vi).corrected_grad_i_Wij. interpretation: Current J route implements the continuous local solid-volume identity,not a literal equation24 transcription. Both continuum meaning and finite-particle/finite-step differences must be distinguished. No relative accuracy claim follows from the identity alone.
